title: Fox dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#2a3a6a'/>

  <path d='M38 30 Q32 16 36 14 Q40 13 44 26 Z' fill='#e8702a'/>
  <path d='M39 28 Q35 19 37 17 Q39 17 42 26 Z' fill='#ffb84d'/>

  <path d='M35 15 Q32 16 35 22 Q37 18 36 15 Z' fill='#3a1a0a'/>

  <!-- Right ear -->
  <path d='M62 30 Q68 16 64 14 Q60 13 56 26 Z' fill='#e8702a'/>

  <path d='M65 15 Q68 16 65 22 Q63 18 64 15 Z' fill='#3a1a0a'/>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='45' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffb84d'/>

  <path d='M41 37 Q44 34 47 37' stroke='#3a1a0a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 37 Q56 34 59 37' stroke='#3a1a0a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#3a1a0a'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='43.5' r='0.8' fill='#6a5a8a'/>

  <!-- Mouth (smiling) -->
  <path d='M47 48 Q50 51 53 48' stroke='#3a1a0a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Music notes -->
  <g fill='#7be0ff'>
    <path d='M22 28 L22 20 L28 18.5 L28 26.5 Z'/>
    <circle cx='20.5' cy='28' r='2.2'/>
    <ellipse cx='26.5' cy='26.5' rx='2.2' ry='1.8' transform='rotate(-15 26.5 26.5)'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ff9be0'>
    <path d='M75 22 L75 15 L80 14 L80 21 Z'/>
    <circle cx='73.5' cy='22' r='2'/>

  </g>
